theorems.name: Submission.simon_submanifold_tangentSpace_eq_range
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), 1 ≤ r → Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
